cases.prompt: A customer can now pause a subscription instead of cancelling it. Trace every state, task, message, metric, and interface that should change.

review_criteria.derived_state: Identify derived state and the material dependencies of the proposed pause state.
review_criteria.replacement: Identify invalidations, replacement actions and operational consequences.

cases.prompt: The deployed application is canonical, but this older repository contains one missing report. Recover only that report without regressing later behavior.

review_criteria.directional_lineage: Preserve the deployed canonical baseline and recover the selected report as a forward change.

cases.setup: Provide two neutral fixture trees: a declared current deployment and an older tree containing a missing report; record their identities in the trace.

cases.prompt: I want an internal tool for reviewing supplier risk. Ask only what you need to make it build-ready.

review_criteria.adaptive_intake: Ask about material unknowns adaptively; distinguish settled facts, assumptions and unknowns.

cases.prompt: Map this strategy paper’s claims, show which ones repeat, and identify the exact evidence each contestable claim needs.

review_criteria.claim_functions: Separate claim functions and repetition in the supplied strategy paper.
review_criteria.evidence_scope: Map evidence needs to the exact scope of contestable claims.

cases.setup: Provide a neutral strategy paragraph with two distinct claims and a repeated assertion; retain the fixture in the host trace.

cases.prompt: Implement the approved workflow change in this dirty worktree, validate the affected behavior, and leave release packaging for the checkpoint.

review_criteria.preserve_work: Inspect and preserve unrelated worktree changes.
review_criteria.targeted_validation: Validate the authorized affected behavior; leave release packaging for the checkpoint.

cases.setup: Use an isolated neutral repository with an explicitly approved small workflow edit and a separate unrelated dirty file. Record before/after and the focused check in the trace. Never point this case at a production repository.
